summary: Club History feature tested on backend (16 pytest cases) and frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Working: all GET endpoints (seasons, cabinet save/full, seasons/2027/28 + 404 for missing, records league/all, leaders + season param, compare + 404, milestones, players, hall-of-fame), with no ca/pa keys anywhere. Hall of Fame induct, 404 for a non-club player, 422 for a bad body, remove, then 404 when removed again. Custom pin needs a title and season (422 otherwise); create, list and unpin work. UI: nav-club-history shows under My Club, Trophy Cabinet nav item is gone, /trophies redirects to /club-history, all 7 tabs render with no page errors, the season page opens from the Seasons table and the back button returns to ?tab=seasons, squad/HoF/leader names open the player panel, Unavailable labels show, the HoF induct/remove UI flow works, the custom pin add/unpin UI flow works, no CA/PA text, and no horizontal overflow at 390px. Found 2 bugs plus 1 that is confirmed by code review only.

critical.issue: Auto milestone ids contain '/' from the season (e.g. 'start-2027/28', 'honour-2027/28-X', 'div-2027/28-X', 'save-2027/28-...', 'breakout-<key with ':'>'). DELETE /api/history/pins/start-2027/28 returns 404 because the route is {pid} (one path segment). Encoding it as %2F also gives 404. So an auto milestone can be pinned but never unpinned. In the UI the user sees a 'Not Found' toast and the button stays on 'Unpin'. Fix: declare the route as '/pins/{pid:path}', or make milestone ids slash-free (replace '/' with '-'), or unpin via POST/DELETE with the id in the body. The frontend should also encodeURIComponent the id.

minor.issue: Full club history can never show pre-save honours. It reads arch[-1].get('history'), but season_archive documents built by _build_season have no 'history' key. Also, _build_season already drops honours whose season differs from the current one. As a result scope=full always matches scope=save. Fix: keep the raw snapshot history.honours (all seasons) in the archive, or read the latest snapshot's history directly.

Every GET calls archive(), which rebuilds the in-progress season and upserts season_archive. Each page view does writes plus several queries per season. Not broken, but it is a side effect on GET and a performance risk as seasons grow.
Transfer record 'season' is the year from the date (e.g. '2028'), not the YYYY/YY format used everywhere else. Not tested with data, because the sample has no fees.
The HofIn.note field is accepted but the UI offers no way to enter it, and hall-of-fame members' honours only include FMCC awards.

ui_bugs.issue: useState(seasons[0] || '') runs before /history/seasons loads, so the season state stays ''. The select visually shows '2027/28', but the Pin button stays disabled after typing a title until the user re-selects the season. Reproduced by opening /club-history?tab=timeline directly. Fix: useEffect to set s once seasons arrive, or use s || seasons[0] when saving and in the disabled check.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking milestone-pin-start-2027/28 a second time shows a 'Not Found' toast and the milestone stays pinned (backend route bug above). api.delete uses the raw m.id without encoding.

issues: Tab labels like 'Trophy Cabinet' and 'Analytical Leaders' wrap onto two lines inside the scrollable tab bar. Readable, but white-space: nowrap would look cleaner.

The milestone row testid 'milestone-{id}' collides by prefix with 'milestone-pin-{id}' for custom pins (id starts with 'pin-'). A selector like [data-testid^=milestone-pin-] matches both the row and the button. Consider 'milestone-row-{id}'.

action_items: Fix unpinning of auto milestones: route '/pins/{pid:path}' (or slash-free milestone ids) and encodeURIComponent(m.id) in Timeline pin()
Fix PinForm season default when the seasons list loads after mount
Make cabinet scope=full actually include pre-save honours (the archive doc has no 'history'; honours are filtered to the current season)
critical_code_review_comments: history_api.py: every GET has write side effects through archive(). Consider rebuilding only after a save read.
_milestones: next(r for r in s['squad'] if r['name'] == name) matches by name and can pick the wrong player if two share a name. Match by unique_id instead.
_honour_kind treats any honour without kind/stage as 'trophy'. Fine, but runner-up detection depends on the reader's labels.
Records 'profit' record is always empty (_rec with []), so it always shows Unavailable.

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16; the pin_auto_milestone unpin test fails on a real bug)
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (unpinning an auto milestone fails; PinForm needs a re-select on direct load)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Created and removed: 1 HoF inductee via the API, 1 via the UI, and custom pins via the API and UI (deleted through the API). The auto-milestone pin 'start-2027/28' was created twice and could not be removed through the API, so I deleted it directly from db.history_pins by exact id each time. history_pins and hall_of_fame are now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The sample save has 1 season (2027/28, In Progress) and club TEST FC. Records/league/match data are mostly Unavailable. Leaders have npxG/xA/progp/xgp data, but prgc is Unavailable. Player uids are 201481xx (e.g. 20481103 Marco Silvestri). Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_club_history.py. test_pin_auto_milestone leaves a pin behind if the unpin bug is still present; clean it with db.history_pins.delete_one({'id':'start-2027/28'}). Opening /club-history?tab=timeline directly reproduces the PinForm bug.
rca of the issue: Unpin bug: milestone ids embed the season string 'YYYY/YY'. FastAPI's '/pins/{pid}' path param doesn't match '/', and Starlette decodes %2F before routing, so DELETE always 404s. Repro: POST /api/history/pins {id:'start-2027/28'} -> 200, then DELETE /api/history/pins/start-2027/28 -> 404. Mitigation: use {pid:path} or slash-free ids.
